prompt: A frame from a 35mm feature film, full-bleed, 16:9: a four-storey Chicago bakery building in 1928, sliced open top to bottom like a life-size film set, every floor visible at once, shot from a low angle in the snow-covered street, slightly off-centre and tilted, the elevated railway's iron legs cutting across the lower left corner.
